instruction: I prefer watching videos with VLC in a cleaner interface. Can you enable the minimal view mode in VLC settings?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1 in vlcrc config file). Similar difficulty to original task - both involve changing a single VLC preference setting.

Metric handles default values correctly (default is 0/disabled) and compares against expected value of 1
